title: Rovibrational energy levels of H$_2$O by quantum computing
summary: We calculate rovibrational energy levels of H$_2$O using a trapped-ion quantum computer. We first derive the qubit form of Watson's Hamiltonian, including the rovibrational coupling terms. In a second step, we employ a variant of the quantum-selected configuration-interaction method to calculate rovibrational energy levels. A truncated form of the qubit Hamiltonian is used to generate correlated rovibrational wave functions on the quantum computer by time evolution, and a basis set is selected by sampling from the measured probability distribution.
